cases.question: How do I create a budget billing plan?
cases.before_answer:
The available SAP Help page explains the purpose and parameters of a budget billing plan, but it does not document the steps to create one.

Utility companies normally bill for their services at the end of a supply period - in an annual consumption billing, for example. [S1]
